status: Plan fixed before this benchmark execution; source data and candidate family were explored previously
question: Apply existing local molecular-only equations unchanged to OMIX002850 and compare with published p-EASI on identical AD participants and visits

core_all__serum3.status: Exploratory refit, not a new frozen clinical calculator

core_all__ccl17.status: Exploratory refit, not a new frozen clinical calculator

local_model_identity: Separate previously fitted exploratory molecular-only ablation models; not the frozen BSA-three-marker hybrid with BSA removed
peasi_coefficients_scope: 2017 full-precision equations primary; 2020 rounded publication equations sensitivity; pretreatment/treatment selects only p-EASI equation
eligibility: Case set with observed EASI in [0,72] and all five nominal serum concentrations finite positive; no imputation, no healthy controls

prediction_scale.sensitivity: Unbounded raw predictions for all methods

strata.paired_change: W16 minus W0 in same patients, computed after pairing; clipped endpoint differences primary, raw endpoint differences sensitivity

confidence_intervals.method: Percentile patient bootstrap; each analysis row is one patient within visit or paired-change stratum; identical resamples used across models

comparisons: Patient-paired MAE difference (local molecular model minus p-EASI); negative favors local model, positive favors p-EASI; precise primary, rounded sensitivity
forbidden: No fitting or tuning on OMIX EASI
No treating repeated visits as independent people
No choosing winner across models after viewing OMIX performance
No pooled correlation as principal result
limitations: OMIX002850 was already explored locally in September 2026; this is a retrospective transport benchmark, not untouched validation
Huashan source may overlap with local participants; unique participant independence not established
Nominal pg/mL does not establish assay equivalence; source CD25/IL2Ra used as soluble IL2R proxy pending assay bridge
No BSA available; this benchmark does not assess the selected BSA-three-marker model
prediction_file_visibility: Private audit export; not to be included in public repository or manuscript package without separate review
